title: Rama's war with Khara's demons
introduction: The ambidextrous archery of Rama is established here for the first time. So far, he has been using his archery sporadically, and here it is said to have a different dimension. The speed with which he draws arrows from quiver, the quickness with which he strings them, and the precision with which he shoots, is suggested here, though not explained. Though no apparent divinity is attached to this excercise, it suggests a divine expertise of a human.

There are fourteen thousand demons against one Rama, and the Divine beings watch this from heavens as a sport, without according any miraculous powers to Rama, suggesting that a human has to face any number of problems, here fourteen thousand demons, for himself and no divine grace suddenly comes to his help.
Rama gives the demons enough time and warning, but as the atrocity is escalating, he uses one gandharva missile and many other arrows, which will devastate the entire army of Dushana's brute force.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे पंच विंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 25th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अवष्टब्ध धनुम् रामम् क्रुद्धम् च रिपु घातिनम् |
ददर्श आश्रमम् आगम्य खरः सह पुरःसरैः
verses.iast:
avaṣṭabdha dhanum rāmam kruddham ca ripu ghātinam |
dadarśa āśramam āgamya kharaḥ saha puraḥsaraiḥ
verses.translation: Khara on arriving at the hermitage along with forerunning soldiers saw the enemy-eliminator and wrathful Rama holding fast to his bow.

glosses.meaning: at Rama, who is holding fast, bow

verses.devanagari:
तम् दृष्ट्वा सगुणम् चापम् उद्यम्य खर निःस्वनम् |
रामस्य अभिमुखम् सूतम् चोद्यताम् इति अचोदयत्
verses.iast:
tam dṛṣṭvā saguṇam cāpam udyamya khara niḥsvanam |
rāmasya abhimukham sūtam codyatām iti acodayat
verses.translation: On seeing Rama that bawling Khara raised his string-taut bow that makes an ass-like braying twang, drove his charioteer crazy saying, "drive to the fore of that Rama..."

glosses.meaning: with, string-taut, bow, on raising up

verses.devanagari:
स खरस्य आज्ञया सूतः तुरगान् समचोदयत् |
यत्र रामो महाबाहुः एको धुन्वन् धनुः स्थितः
verses.iast:
sa kharasya ājñayā sūtaḥ turagān samacodayat |
yatra rāmo mahābāhuḥ eko dhunvan dhanuḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: On the orders of Khara the charioteer drove the horses to there where the mighty armed Rama is standing single-handedly while swaying his bow.

glosses.meaning: where he is, bow, while swaying, standing

verses.devanagari:
तम् तु निष्पतितम् दृष्ट्वा सर्वे ते रजनी चराः |
मुंचमाना महानादम् सचिवाः पर्यवारयन्
verses.iast:
tam tu niṣpatitam dṛṣṭvā sarve te rajanī carāḥ |
muṃcamānā mahānādam sacivāḥ paryavārayan
verses.translation: On seeing Khara descending on Rama then all those nightwalkers who are the deputies of Khara encircled Khara venting out loud battle cries.

glosses.meaning: who has fallen in - descended on
him, but - for their part, on seeing

verses.devanagari:
स तेषाम् यातुधानानाम् मध्ये रथः गतः खरः |
बभूव मध्ये ताराणाम् लोहिता.ंग इव उदितः
verses.iast:
sa teṣām yātudhānānām madhye rathaḥ gataḥ kharaḥ |
babhūva madhye tārāṇām lohitā.ṃga iva uditaḥ
verses.translation: Khara staying on his chariot in the thick of those demons appeared to be like coppery-red planet Mars up-shot in the thick of stars.

glosses.meaning: in chariot, staying, he, that Khara
up-shot, copper, coloured bodied one - Mars

verses.devanagari:
ततः शर सहस्रेन रामम् अप्रतिम ओजसम् |
अर्दयित्वाअ महानादम् ननाद समरे खरः
verses.iast:
tataḥ śara sahasrena rāmam apratima ojasam |
ardayitvāa mahānādam nanāda samare kharaḥ
verses.translation: In his proneness to war then Khara assaulted that uniquely forceful Rama with a thousand arrows and blared a roaring battle cry.

glosses.meaning: Khara, in combat - prone to a combat

verses.devanagari:
ततः तम् भीम धन्वानम् क्रुद्धाः सर्वे निशाचराः |
रामम् नाना विधैः शस्त्रैः अभ्यवर्षन्त दुर्जयम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ tam bhīma dhanvānam kruddhāḥ sarve niśācarāḥ |
rāmam nānā vidhaiḥ śas.htraiḥ abhyavarṣanta durjayam
verses.translation: All of those infuriated nightwalkers then incessantly rained diverse weapons on that invincibleRama who is handling a horrific bow.

glosses.meaning: with many, types, of weapons, much [incessantly] rained.

verses.devanagari:
मुद्गरैः आयसैः शूलैः प्रासैः खड्गैः परश्वधैः |
राक्षसाः समरे रामम् निजघ्नू रोष तत्पराः
verses.iast:
mudgaraiḥ āyasaiḥ śūlaiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ |
rākṣasāḥ samare rāmam nijaghnū roṣa tatparāḥ
verses.translation: Those demons that are already caught up with rancour bombarded Rama with bludgeons, lances, tridents, darts and hatchets.

glosses.meaning: demons, to rancour, indulged - caught up

glosses.itrans: mudgaraiH aayasaiH shuulaiH praasaiH khaDgaiH parashvadhaiH
glosses.iast: mudgaraiḥ āyasaiḥ śūlaiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ
glosses.devanagari: मुद्गरैः आयसैः शूलैः प्रासैः खड्गैः परश्वधैः
glosses.meaning: with bludgeons, lances, tridents, darts, hatchets

verses.devanagari:
ते वलाहक संकाशा महाकाया महाबलाः |
अभ्यधावन्त काकुत्स्थम् रथैः वाजिभिः एव च
गजैः पर्वत कूट अभैः रामम् युद्धे जिंघासवः |
verses.iast:
te valāhaka saṅkāśā mahākāyā mahābalāḥ |
abhyadhāvanta kākutstham rathaiḥ vājibhiḥ eva ca
gajaiḥ parvata kūṭa abhaiḥ rāmam yuddhe jiṅghāsavaḥ |
verses.translation: Those massive bodied and exceptionally mighty demons came jostling like immense clouds in their eagerness to kill Rama in that war, while some mounted on chariots and horsebacks, and some more riding mountain-ridges like elephants rushed in on Rama.

glosses.meaning: in war, Rama, eager to kill
towards Rama, they rushed in on.

verses.devanagari:
ते रामे शर वर्षाणि व्यसृजन् रक्षसाम् गणाः
शैलेन्द्रम् इव धाराभिर् वर्षमाणा महाधनाः |
verses.iast:
te rāme śara varṣāṇi vyasṛjan rakṣasām gaṇāḥ
śailendram iva dhārābhir varṣamāṇā mahādhanāḥ |
verses.translation: And those bands of demons have outpoured arrows on Rama, as with enormous black-clouds disemboguing torrents on a lofty mountain.

glosses.meaning: on mountain, the best - lofty one, as with

verses.devanagari:
सर्वैः परिवृतो रामो राक्षसैः कॄरदर्शिनैः
तिथिषु इव महादेवो वृतः पारिषदाम् गणैः |
verses.iast:
sarvaiḥ parivṛto rāmo rākśasaiḥ kṝradarśinaiḥ
tithiṣu iva mahādevo vṛtaḥ pāriṣadām gaṇaiḥ |
verses.translation: When hemmed in with those grisly-looking demons Rama appeared like Rudra surrounded by his divine retinue called prathama gaNa-s, on certain days, whereupon he starts his all-destructive cosmic-dance.

glosses.meaning: by all, demons, by demons, grisly, in their appearance
retinue, group of, surrounded, as with

verses.devanagari:
तानि मुक्तानि शस्त्राणि यातुधानैः स राघवः
प्रतिजग्राह विशिखैः नदि ओघान् इव सागरः |
verses.iast:
tāni muk{}tāni śastrāṇi yātudhānaiḥ sa rāghavaḥ
pratijagrāha viśikhaiḥ nadi oghān iva sāgaraḥ |
verses.translation: That Raghava has pre-empted those arrows discharged by the demons with his excruciatingly pointed arrows as an ocean would do with the river's onrush.

verses.devanagari:
स तैः प्रहरणैः घोरैः भिन्न गात्रो न विव्यथे
रामः प्रदीप्तैर् बहुभिर् वज्रैर् इव महा अचलः |
verses.iast:
sa taiḥ praharaṇaiḥ ghoraiḥ bhinna gātro na vivyathe
rāmaḥ pradīptair bahubhir vajrair iva mahā acalaḥ |
verses.translation: Even if his body is gashed with those gruesome assault weapons Rama is not enfeebled, as with the enormous Mt. Meru that can withstand even if battered by very many highly blazing thunderbolts of Indra.

glosses.meaning: gruesome one, with those, assault weapons
enormous, not, moving one - mountain [Mt. Meru,] as with
not, at all, hurt - not rendered feeble.

verses.devanagari:
स विद्धः क्षतज दिग्धः सर्व गात्रेषु राघवः
बभूव रामः सन्ध्य अभ्रैः दिवाकर इव आवृतः |
verses.iast:
sa viddhaḥ kṣataja digdhaḥ sarva gātreṣu rāghavaḥ
babhūva rāmaḥ sandhya abhraiḥ divākara iva āvṛtaḥ |
verses.translation: Bruised and bedaubed with blood on all his limbs that Rama of Raghu's dynasty took shape of the sun enshrouded by cloudscapes at eventide.
notes: Rama is not fading away like the evening sun but becoming more like blood red sun. The 'covering of blood' on his limbs suggests the covering of reddish flaring fire on all his limbs, as we say that evening sun is stained with blood and fire.

glosses.meaning: one from the dynasty of Raghu-s
of eventide, by cloudscapes, covered with

verses.devanagari:
विषेदुर् देव गन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः च परम ऋषयः
एकम् सहस्रैः बहुभिः तदा दृष्ट्वा समावृतम् |
verses.iast:
viṣedur deva gandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca parama ṛṣayaḥ
ekam sahasraiḥ bahubhiḥ tadā dṛṣṭvā samāvṛtam |
verses.translation: On seeing lone Rama beset by many demons, then the gods, celestials, saints and sublime-sages are dispirited.

glosses.itrans: deva gandharvaaH siddhaaH parama R^iSayaH ca
glosses.iast: deva gandharvāḥ siddhāḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ ca
glosses.devanagari: देव गन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः परम ऋषयः च

verses.devanagari:
ततो रामः तु सुसंक्रुद्धो मण्डली कृत कार्मुकः
ससर्ज निशितान् बाणान् शतशः अथ सहस्रशः |
verses.iast:
tato rāmaḥ tu susaṅkruddho maṇḍalī kṛta kārmukaḥ
sasarja niśitān bāṇān śataśaḥ atha sahasraśaḥ |
verses.translation: But Rama on becoming highly infuriated curved his bow to a full circularity on stretching the bowstring up to his ear, and then jetted out trenchant arrows in hundreds. Why hundreds? He surged them in thousands.

verses.devanagari:
दुरवारान् दुर्विषहान् कालपाश उपमान् रणे
मुमोच लीलया रामः कंकपत्रान् कांचन भूषणान् |
verses.iast:
duravārān dur.hviṣahān kālapāśa upamān raṇe
mumoca līlayā rāmaḥ kaṃkapatrān kāṃcana bhūṣaṇān |
verses.translation: In that war Rama sportily discharged eagle-feathered arrows adorned in gold which are unstoppable and intolerable, and which in simile are the leads of Time-god.

glosses.meaning: impossible, not to, stop - unstoppable ones
impossible, to verily, tolerate - intolerable ones

verses.devanagari:
ते शराः शत्रु सैन्येषु मुक्ता रामेण लीलया
आददू रक्षसाम् प्राणान् पाशाः कालकृता इव |
verses.iast:
te śarāḥ śatru sainyeṣu muk{}tā rāmeṇa līlayā
ādadū rakṣasām prāṇān pāśāḥ kālakṛtā iva |
verses.translation: Those arrows that are playfully discharged on the army of enemy have grabbed the lives of demons like the tethers flung by the Time-god.

glosses.meaning: by Time-god, made [flung,] tethers, as with

verses.devanagari:
भित्त्वा राक्षस देहान् ताम् ते शरा रुधिर आप्लुताः
अंतरिक्ष गता रेजुः दीप्त अग्नि सम तेजसः |
verses.iast:
bhittvā rākṣasa dehān tām te śarā rudhira āplutāḥ
aṃtarikṣa gatā rejuḥ dīpta agni sama tejasaḥ |
verses.translation: On impaling the bodies demons, the arrows swamped in blood have gone into welkin, where they are aglow with flares equalling inflamed flames.
notes: The similitude between redness of blood and the redness of flaring fire is again suggested, as said at 3-25-14b, 15a above.

glosses.meaning: inflamed, flame, equal, with the flare

verses.devanagari:
असंख्येयाः तु रामस्य सायकाः चाप मण्डलात्
विनिष्पेतुः अतीव उग्रा रक्षः प्राण अपहारिणः |
verses.iast:
asaṃkhyeyāḥ tu rāmasya sāyakāḥ cāpa maṇḍalāt
viniṣpetuḥ atīva ugrā rakṣaḥ prāṇa apahāriṇaḥ |
verses.translation: Innumerable and highly frightening arrows fusilladed from the nimbus of the bow of Rama that resulted as the filchers of the lives of demons.

glosses.meaning: bow's, from nimbus - from circularly bent arrow

verses.devanagari:
तैः धनूंषि ध्वज अग्राणि चर्माणि च शिरांसि च
बहून् स हस्त आभरणान् ऊरून् करि कर उपमान् |
चिछ्हेद रामः समरे शतशः अथ सहस्रशः
verses.iast:
taiḥ dhanūṃṣi dhvaja agrāṇi carmāṇi ca śirāṃsi ca
bahūn sa hasta ābharaṇān ūrūn kari kara upamān |
cichheda rāmaḥ samare śataśaḥ atha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: In that war, shooting now with hundreds, and now with thousands of such arrows, Rama shredded those many bows, pinnacles of war-flags, armours and the like. And even shred are the heads of demons, along with their ornamented arms and thighs similar to the trunks of elephants.

verses.devanagari:
हयान् कांचन सन्नाहान् रथ युक्तान् स सारथीन् |
गजाम् च स गज आरोहान् स हयान् सारधिनः तदा
चिछ्हिदुः बिभिदुः च एव राम बाणा गुण च्युताः |
पदातीन् समरे हत्वा हि अनयत् यम सदनम्
verses.iast:
hayān kāṃcana sannāhān ratha yuk{}tān sa sārathīn |
gajām ca sa gaja ārohān sa hayān sāradhinaḥ tadā
cichhiduḥ bibhiduḥ ca eva rāma bāṇā guṇa cyutāḥ |
padātīn samare hatvā hi anayat yama sadanam
verses.translation: With the arrows flung from the bow-bowstring-nimbus of Rama, he indeed shredded and scraped the horses hitched with golden harnesses, and the chariots to which they are yoked, and even their charioteers. Likewise, he even ripped off the elephants along with their riders, and the horses along with their cavaliers. And on eliminating infantrymen in that war Rama led them to the abode of Yama, the Time-god. [3-25-23, 24]

glosses.meaning: Rama's, bow's, string, fallen from [with arrows]
with, elephants, along with those that are riding

verses.devanagari:
ततो नालीक नाराचैः तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः विकर्णिभिः |
भीमम् आर्त स्वरम् चक्रुः छ्हिद्यमाना निशाचराः
verses.iast:
tato nālīka nārācaiḥ tīkśṇa agraiḥ vikarṇibhiḥ |
bhīmam ārta svaram cakruḥ chhidyamānā niśācarāḥ
verses.translation: While ripped to pieces with tubular arrows, with arrows made of iron, and with sharp-edged and crescent-tipped arrows those demons have let out disgusting cries of anguish.

verses.devanagari:
तत् सैन्यम् निशितैः बाणैः अर्दितम् मर्म भेदिभिः |
न रामेण सुखम् लेभे शुष्कम् वनम् इव अग्निना
verses.iast:
tat sainyam niśitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ arditam marma bhedibhiḥ |
na rāmeṇa sukham lebhe śuṣkam vanam iva agninā
verses.translation: When those arrows that gore the critical parts are thus harrowing, that army is discomposed like a forest burnt to a cinder by wild-fire.

glosses.meaning: dried-up - burnt to a cinder, forest, by wild fire, as with
pleasure, not, they have taken - disquieted.

verses.devanagari:
केचिद् भीम बलाः शूराः प्रासान् शूलान् परश्वधान् |
चिक्षिपुः परम क्रुद्धा रामाय रजनीचराः
verses.iast:
kecid bhīma balāḥ śūrāḥ prāsān śūlān paraśvadhān |
cikṣipuḥ parama kruddhā rāmāya rajanīcarāḥ
verses.translation: Some of the grotesquely sinewy and braving nightwalkers are highly enraged and dashed their darts, tridents, and hatchets towards Rama.

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् बाणैः महाबाहुः शस्त्राणि आवार्य वीर्यवान् |
जहार समरे प्राणान् चिच्छ्हेद च शिरो धरान्
verses.iast:
teṣām bāṇaiḥ mahābāhuḥ śastrāṇi āvārya vīryavān |
jahāra samare prāṇān cicchheda ca śiro dharān
verses.translation: On fending off those weapons with his arrows that mighty armed and valorous Rama filched away their lives by shearing off their necks in that war.

glosses.meaning: sheared off, praaNaan jahaara ca = filched, lives, also.

verses.devanagari:
ते छ्हिन्न शिरसः पेतुः छ्हिन्न चर्म शरासनाः |
सुपर्ण वात विक्षिप्ता जगत्याम् पादपा यथा
verses.iast:
te chhinna śirasaḥ petuḥ chhinna carma śarāsanāḥ |
suparṇa vāta vikśiptā jagatyām pādapā yathā
verses.translation: Those demons crashed down to earth with their heads severed and shields and bows wrecked, like the trees strewn around on earth owing to the gust raised by Garuda, the Divine Eagle, when he takes a sudden flight in heavens.

glosses.meaning: by Garuda, Divine-eagle, its gust, strewn around

verses.devanagari:
अवशिष्टाः च ये तत्र विषण्णाः ते निशाचराः |
खरम् एव अभ्यधावन्त शरणार्थम् शर आहताः
verses.iast:
avaśiṣṭāḥ ca ye tatra viṣaṇṇāḥ te niśācarāḥ |
kharam eva abhyadhāvanta śaraṇārtham śara āhatāḥ
verses.translation: Those nightwalkers that are battered by those arrows and remaining there, they desperately rushed towards Khara alone seeking shelter.

verses.devanagari:
तान् सर्वान् धनुर् आदाय समाश्वास्य च दूषणः |
अभ्यधावत सुसंक्रुद्धः क्रुद्धः [रुद्रम्] क्रुद्ध इव अन्तकः
verses.iast:
tān sarvān dhanur ādāya samāśvāsya ca dūṣaṇaḥ |
abhyadhāvata susaṅkruddhaḥ kruddhaḥ [rudram] kruddha iva antakaḥ
verses.translation: Comforting all of them and taking his bow, very highly infuriated Duushana rushed towards that infuriated Rama like the furious Eliminator Yama.
notes: The second meaning can be expressed by substituting the word 'kruddha' with 'rudra' as in other mms than that of Gorakhpur version.

verses.devanagari:
निवृत्ताः तु पुनः सर्वे दूषण आश्रय निर्भयाः |
रामम् एव अभ्यधावन्त साल ताल शिल आयुधाः
verses.iast:
nivṛttāḥ tu punaḥ sarve dūṣaṇa āśraya nirbhayāḥ |
rāmam eva abhyadhāvanta sāla tāla śila āyudhāḥ
verses.translation: Coming under the shelter of Duushana all of those demons are but emboldened and returned, and they once again rushed towards Rama with saala trees, palm trees and boulders as their weapons.

glosses.meaning: Duushana, in shelter of, without, fear - emboldened
saala trees, palm trees, boulders, as weapons

verses.devanagari:
शूल मुद्गर हस्ताः च पाश हस्ता महाबलाः |
सृजन्तः शर वर्षाणि शस्त्र वर्षाणि संयुगे
द्रुम वर्षाणि मुंचन्तः शिला वर्षाणि राक्षसाः |
verses.iast:
śūla mudgara hastāḥ ca pāśa hastā mahābalāḥ |
sṛjantaḥ śara varṣāṇi śastra varṣāṇi saṃyuge
druma varṣāṇi muṃcantaḥ śilā varṣāṇi rākśasāḥ |
verses.translation: Handling tridents, maces, and leashes those great-mighty demons have created torrents of arrows, missiles, trees and boulders, and inundated Rama in that war.

glosses.meaning: tridents, maces, in hands, along with

verses.devanagari:
तद् बभूव अद्भुतम् युद्धम् तुमुलम् रोम हर्षणम्
रामस्य अस्य महाघोरम् पुनः तेषाम् च रक्षसाम् |
verses.iast:
tad babhūva adbhutam yuddham tumulam roma harṣaṇam
rāmasya asya mahāghoram punaḥ teṣām ca rakṣasām |
verses.translation: Again there chanced a highly gruesome war between Rama and those demons that is tumultuous, stunning, and a hair-raising.

verses.devanagari:
ते समन्तात् अभिक्रुद्धा राघवम् पुनर् आर्दयन्
ततः सर्वा दिशो दृष्ट्वा प्रदिशाः च समावृताः |
राक्षसैः सर्वतः प्राप्तैः शर वर्षाभिः आवृतः
स कृत्वा भैरवम् नादम् अस्त्रम् परम भास्वरम्|
समयोजयत् गान्धर्वम् राक्षसेषु महाबलः
verses.iast:
te samantāt abhikruddhā rāghavam punar ārdayan
tataḥ sarvā diśo dṛṣṭvā pradiśāḥ ca samāvṛtāḥ |
rākśasaiḥ sarvataḥ prāptaiḥ śara varṣābhiḥ āvṛtaḥ
sa kṛtvā bhairavam nādam astram parama bhāsvaram |
samayojayat gāndharvam rākśaseṣu mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Those demons have resurfaced from all around pressurising Raghava in high dudgeon. On seeing the reappearance of demons from everywhere, with whom all the directions and inter-directions are fully filled, and who are storming torrents of arrows, then that exceptionally forceful Rama made a thunderous sound and launched an extremely blazing missile among the gather of demons, called gandharva missile.

verses.devanagari:
ततः शर सहस्राणि निर्ययुः चाप मण्डलात् |
सर्वा दश दिशो बानैः आपूर्यन्त समागतैः
verses.iast:
tataḥ śara sahasrāṇi niryayuḥ cāpa maṇḍalāt |
sarvā daśa diśo bānaiḥ āpūryanta samāgataiḥ
verses.translation: Then from the nimbus of his bow, arrows in thousand have scurried out, and with them thus arrived all the ten sides are cramped up.

verses.devanagari:
न आददानाम् शरान् घोरान् विमुंचंतम् शर उत्तमान् |
विकर्षमाणम् पश्यन्ति राक्षसाः ते शर आर्दिताः
verses.iast:
na ādadānām śarān ghorān vimuṃcaṃtam śara uttamān |
vikarṣamāṇam paśyanti rākśasāḥ te śara ārditāḥ
verses.translation: Either the drawing of those supreme arrows from the quiver, or the traction of bowstring on placing them, or unloosing them from the bow is unperceived by those demons that are harrowing under those arrows.

verses.devanagari:
शर अन्धकारम् आकाशम् आवृणोत् स दिवाकरम् |
बभूव अवस्थितो रामः प्रक्षिपन् इव तान् शरान्
verses.iast:
śara andhakāram ākāśam āvṛṇot sa divākaram |
babhūva avasthito rāmaḥ prakśipan iva tān śarān
verses.translation: Darkness caused by the thick of the arrows overspread the sky including its sun, while Rama happened to persevere spewing forth his arrows.
notes: Dark grew the air with arrowy hail / Which hid the sun as with a veil. - Griffith.

verses.devanagari:
युगपत् पतमानैः च युगपच्च हतैः भ्रिशम् |
युगपत् पतितैः चैव विकीर्णा वसुधा अभवत्
verses.iast:
yugapat patamānaiḥ ca yugapacca hataiḥ bhriśam |
yugapat patitaiḥ caiva vikīrṇā vasudhā abhavat
verses.translation: Far and wide the earth is scattered with herds that are falling instantaneously, hosts that have fallen instantly, and huddles that are already felled with an instantaneity.
notes: Fiends wounded, falling, fallen, slain, / All in a moment, spread the plain, - Griffith.

glosses.meaning: in a trice, falling down, and
in a trice, fallen down, also thus
far and wide, scattered [with them,] became.

verses.devanagari:
निहताः पतिताः क्षीणा च्छ्हिन्न भिन्न विदारिताः |
तत्र तत्र स्म दृश्यन्ते राक्षसाः ते सहस्रशः
verses.iast:
nihatāḥ patitāḥ kśīṇā cchhinna bhinna vidāritāḥ |
tatra tatra sma dṛśyante rākśasāḥ te sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Thousands of demons are noticeable hither and yon, killed, fallen and enfeebled, and slashed, gashed and ripped.
notes: And thousands scarce alive were left / Mangled, and gashed, and torn, and cleft. - Griffith.

verses.devanagari:
स उष्णीषैः उत्तम अंगैः च स अ.ंगदैः बाहुभिः तथा |
ऊरुभिः बाहुभिः च्छ्हिन्नैः नाना रूपैः विभूषणैः
हयैः च द्विप मुख्यैः च रथैः भिन्नैः अनेकशः |
चामर व्यजनैः छ्हत्रैः ध्वजैः नाना विधैः अपि
रामेण बाण अभिहतैः विच्छ्हिन्नैः शूल पट्टिशैः |
खड्गैः खण्डीकृतैः प्रासैः विकीर्णैः च पश्वधैः
चूणिताभिः शिलाभिः च शरैः चित्रैः अनेकशः |
विच्छ्हिन्नैः समरे भूमिः विस्तीर्णा आभूत् भयंकरा
verses.iast:
sa uṣṇīṣaiḥ uttama aṃgaiḥ ca sa a.ṃgadaiḥ bāhubhiḥ tathā |
ūrubhiḥ bāhubhiḥ cchhinnaiḥ nānā rūpaiḥ vibhūṣaṇaiḥ
hayaiḥ ca dvipa mukhyaiḥ ca rathaiḥ bhinnaiḥ anekaśaḥ |
cāmara vyajanaiḥ chhatraiḥ dhvajaiḥ nānā vidhaiḥ api
rāmeṇa bāṇa abhihataiḥ vicchhinnaiḥ śūla paṭṭiśaiḥ |
khaḍgaiḥ khaṇḍīkṛtaiḥ prāsaiḥ vikīrṇaiḥ ca paśvadhaiḥ
cūṇitābhiḥ śilābhiḥ ca śaraiḥ citraiḥ anekaśaḥ |
vicchhinnaiḥ samare bhūmiḥ vistīrṇā ābhūt bhayaṅkarā
verses.translation: Some severed heads still have their headgears and some bare, some arms are with armlets and some bare, while some with their arms cut off, some with their thighs cut off, some with their divers patterns of ornaments on their bodies have fallen on ground. Numerous horses and elephants are felled. Chariots, royal-fans, royal-parasols, war-flags of very many kinds are ravaged in many ways. Hit down by Rama's arrows spears and tridents are variously splintered, swords broken to pieces, darts and hatchets shattered and strewn around. Also the boulders are pulverised, various amazing arrows have gone to rack and ruin in many ways. Spread with such wreckage the earth has become horrifying for a glance.

glosses.meaning: with, bicep-lets, with arms, cChinnaiH uurubhiH = cut off, with thighs
to pieces, made as - broken to pieces
in many ways, gone to rack and ruin

verses.devanagari:
तान् दृष्ट्वा निहतान् सर्वे रक्षसाः परम आतुराः |
न तत्र चलितुम् शक्ता रामम् पर पुरंजयम्
verses.iast:
tān dṛṣṭvā nihatān sarve rakśasāḥ parama āturāḥ |
na tatra calitum śak{}tā rāmam para purañjayam
verses.translation: On seeing the killed demons all the surviving demons have become enervated and they are rendered incapable to make a move towards Rama, the conqueror of enemy's capitals.

glosses.meaning: there, to make a move, not, capable of
